answer: Seats pay their entry in useful work. Each epoch a key earns only after returning 6 GPU-hours of BOINC-style science units, such as harbor storm-surge runs or juniper drought models, signed with its key. Every unit also goes to 2 unrelated hosts and counts only if results agree, so faked output fails quorum. An extra identity costs about $2.50 of rented GPU per epoch, linear in N: 100 clones burn $250 each epoch. Hosts with matching benchmark timings merge into one seat, and the spend becomes a bridge to real research instead of waste.
